messages.subject: Installing INLA on offline computer
parts: I'm working on a computer that must be offline due to security reasons. What would be the best way to install INLA and the related R package? It seems like the compile-it-your-self-way also requires internet connection.

messages.author: b453c29749de564d
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Installing INLA on offline computer
parts:
On Thu, 2016-06-02 at 08:49 -0700, Erling Lundevaller wrote:
> I'm working on a computer that must be offline due to security
> reasons. What would be the best way to install INLA and the related R
> package? It seems like the compile-it-your-self-way also requires
> internet connection.

Hi

then you have to download it manually from

http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/R/testing/bin/macosx/contrib/3.3/


f.ex, if you have a mac, or just enter higher in the hieracy to find
the win or linux packages. 


and then 

R CMD INSTALL package.tgz

where you copy package.tgz from a USB or something to the off-line
machine


H
